title: design-previews
description: The previews of releases that move other groups' values, and the answers to them: each group whose release in today's design is not the one in the design released now, and every preview read back; or why there are none, when the design open is not today's.

previews_on.description: The design released now, which a preview is on; empty before the first.

previews_said.description: Why there is no design to preview on, when there is none.

pending.description: Each group whose release in today's design is not the one in the design released now.

held.description: The release the design released now holds of it; empty where it holds none.

preview.description: The preview of it on the design released now, on the drive or in your copy; empty where there is none.

previews.description: Every preview on the drive, and in your copy where the drive does not hold it, read back through the chain.

path.description: integration/<g>-<v>/preview-<g>-<v>-on-<design>.vleo, or integration/ when that folder does not read.

in.description: the drive, or your copy, not put back yet

why.description: Why it does not open, when it does not.

based_on.description: The released design it is on.

stale.description: Whether it is on a design other than the one released now.

group.description: The group it hangs under, or the design.

before.description: The engine's answer on the design released now; null where it refused.

after.description: The engine's answer with the release in it; null where it refused.

why.description: Why the answer there does not count, for one refused.

in_copy.description: Whether an answer is in your copy and not on the drive: written, not put back, so it does not count yet.

answers.description: What each group named has said, as the drive's answers say it, unanswered first.
